transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?
I just don’t seem to have the push I used to. I used to go to choir, do my quilting, visit with people. Now most days I just sit at home with the TV on low, even though I know folks are expecting me.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
It’s been building since I retired from the school office—so, a little over two years now.
During these past two years, have there been any stretches where you felt back to your normal self?
I’m not sure what you mean by normal. I haven’t really paid attention to it in stretches like that.
Aside from lacking energy and drive, how has your mood or spirits been most days?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to my mood, exactly. I just know I don’t feel like doing much anymore.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical conditions or noticed any changes in your physical health?
I haven’t been diagnosed with anything that I know of. I haven’t really noticed any big changes in my physical health either.
Before you retired two years ago, had you ever gone through a period like this in your life?
I don’t know. I can’t really think of a time before then that was like this.
How has your sleep been over these past couple of years?
I’m not sure, really. I haven’t paid much attention to my sleep over that time.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite lately?
I haven’t really noticed any change in my appetite lately.
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future?
I’m not really sure what to expect, but I haven’t been thinking much about the future.
Have you noticed any difficulty with your concentration?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed problems with my concentration.
How have you been feeling about yourself lately, in terms of your self-esteem or confidence?
I don’t feel like I have the push I used to. I used to go to choir, do quilting, visit people... now I mostly just sit at home with the TV on low, even though I know folks expect me.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn't worth living, or thoughts of harming yourself?
No, I haven’t had thoughts like that.
Have you found it harder than usual to make everyday decisions?
I’m not sure what you mean exactly. I haven’t really noticed anything different with making decisions.
When you do sit down to quilt, sing, or watch TV, are you still able to enjoy those things?
Not really like I used to. I’ll have the TV on low, or think about quilting or choir, but I just can’t seem to get myself into it.
Have you been feeling down on yourself, or having feelings of guilt or worthlessness?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really been blaming myself or feeling worthless.
Have you ever experienced a period of time where you felt unusually energetic, keyed up, or like you didn't need any sleep?
No, I can’t say I’ve had a time like that.
